statement: ALSA UCM's pinned USB-Audio matcher extracts the USB vendor/product identifier from CardComponents and selects Sony/DualSense-PS5 for USB 054c:0ce6 (DualSense) and USB 054c:0df2 (DualSense Edge), then includes the selected profile. This describes USB sound-card UCM selection; it is not HID sibling discovery and is distinct from the separately recorded four-output/two-input UCM channel-role claim.

applicability.scope: ALSA ucm2/USB-Audio/USB-Audio.conf lines 7-45, 149-151, 295-318. The USB ID matcher is a consumer configuration rule, not physical-speaker matching.
